levelledPara.title: Equipment Modification Placard

listItem.para: For Equipment Modification Placard, refer to Modification Placard.

note.notePara: The equipment modification placard PN 00-6414 ALT PN F0554722 must be installed near the existing equipment identification placard.
Use self-adhesive transparent plastic film PN AE404 ALT PN F261378 to prevent damage to the surface of the equipment modification placard PN 00-6414 ALT PN F0554722.

levelledPara.para: Add or complete the equipment modification placard PN 00-6414 ALT PN F0554722 on each modified equipment to indicate to indicate that a Service Bulletin and its revision has been completed.

levelledPara.title: Component Modification Placard

listItem.para: For Equipment Modification Placard, refer to Modification Placard.

note.notePara: The component modification placard PN F0523885 ALT PN F0555661 must be installed near the existing Component identification Placard.
Use self-adhesive transparent plastic film PN AE404 ALT PN F261378 to prevent damage to the surface of the component modification placard PN F0523885 ALT PN F0555661.

levelledPara.para: Add or complete the equipment modification placard PN 00-6414 ALT PN F0554722 on each modified equipment to indicate to indicate that a Service Bulletin and its revision has been completed.

In the case when an equipment has the previous identification placard PN 00-5008, 00-5007-1, 00-5007-2 , 00-7219, 00-7219-1 or ETSO placard 00-7367 or, modification placard PN 00-6414 or 00-7371 or bar code PN 00-7370 containing a legible information of equipment, it is not mandatory to replace them.

When a SB kit is ordered containing the previous identification placard PN 00-5008, 00-5007-1, 00-5007-200-7219, 00-7219-1 or ETSO placard 00-7367 or modification placard PN 00-6414, 00- 7371 or bar code placard PN 00-7370 or plug-in table placard PN F0537611, the new identification placard PN F0554720, F0554715, F0554716 , F0554721 or ETSO placard F0554712 or modification placard PN F0554722, F0554723 or bar code placard F0554713 or plug-in table placard F0554719 will be received instead.

The transparent film PN PDFILMPP100X65 (article code F261378) is replaced by PN AE404 (article code F261378). If it is available in stock, the PN PDFILMPP100X65 (article code F261378) can be used. It is not mandatory to replace those which are already on the equipments.
When a SB kit is ordered containing the previous transparent film PN PDFILMPP100X65 (article code F261378), the new PN AE404 (article code F261378) will be received instead.
This SIL0005 can be used as an interchangeability document regarding the identification, modification placards and the transparent film.
